run_MLP_benchmark: run a PyTorch MLP benchmark measuring inference performance on CPU, GPU, or NNPI devices
create_Net_model: create a multi-layer linear neural network with configurable input, hidden, output sizes and layer count
run_infer_cpu: run CPU inference benchmark on a PyTorch model with configurable batch size and warmup steps
run_infer_gpu: run GPU inference benchmark on a PyTorch model with optional TensorRT or MIGraphX acceleration
run_infer_nnpi: run NNPI inference benchmark using torch_glow to compile and execute a traced PyTorch model
